s1.title: Welcome to Bubble.up
s1.body: Your campus, bubbled up. Find your people, study together, and never grind alone. Let's take a quick tour. You can press Skip tutorial in the top right anytime.

s2.title: This is Home
s2.body: Everything happening across your study groups lands right here, your one place to keep up.

s3.title: Live
s3.body: Sessions and study rooms happening right now. Jump in with one click.

s4.title: Upcoming
s4.body: Events and expert sessions coming up, all gathered in one place so nothing slips by.

s5.title: Activity
s5.body: New members, fresh files, and unread messages. A live feed of everything going on.

s6.title: Step into a Bubble
s6.body: These are your Bubbles. Click CS101 Night Owls to step inside.

s7.title: This is a Bubble
s7.body: A study group's home base. Chat, calendar, shared files, and live rooms, all in one place.

s8.title: The Chat
s8.body: Messages, polls, and shared links live here. It's the heart of every Bubble.

s9.title: Say hi
s9.body: Type a message in the box and press Enter to continue. Emojis are welcome.

s10.title: Customize your view
s10.body: Each panel can take center stage. Click the pulsing ⤢ maximize icon on the Calendar to focus it.

s11.title: Plan something
s11.body: Click 'New event', fill in a quick study session, and create it.

s12.title: Now the Files
s12.body: Maximize the Files panel. It's your Bubble's shared shelf of notes and past exams.

s13.title: Take a peek
s13.body: Open Syllabus.pdf. It previews right here, no download needed.

s14.title: Share it
s14.body: Open any event, then tap 'Share to chat'. It drops the event right into your chat for everyone.

s14b.title: There it is
s14b.body: And it lands in the chat as a card the whole Bubble can see. One tap, shared.

s15.title: And when it's crunch time
s15.body: A Bubble can open a live room with video, voice, and a shared whiteboard. Don't start one now, but give it a try later while you explore.

s16.title: Back Home
s16.body: Click the Home button to head back.

s17.title: Explore
s17.body: This is where Bubble.up finds the groups you'll click with. Right now it only shows Trending ones, because we don't know you yet.

s18.title: Let's get to know you
s18.body: Bubble.up learns who you are from quick popup questions and from how you act in the app, then matches you to Bubbles where you'll fit best.

s19.title: Here's one now
s19.body: Answer this quick question. It's how your match profile starts forming.

s20.title: Want sharper matches?
s20.body: Let's answer a few more. Head to Settings.

s22.title: Build your profile
s22.body: Answer a few questions. We'll move on the moment your profile is ready.

s24.title: Look at that
s24.body: Real matched Bubbles now, each with your fit score. Let's pick one from Explore and join it. And the more you use Bubble.up, the sharper your matches get.

s24b.title: Choose a matched Bubble to join
s24b.body: Tap a matched Bubble to open it, then hit Join to add it to your Bubbles.

s25.title: That's the tour
s25.body: The campus is yours now. Explore, chat, plan, and build your profile. Nothing here is real, so go wild.
